name: Longbraid the Grim
summary: Outside fallen Dun Modr, Longbraid the Grim keeps watch over the northern Wetlands. He mourns his brother and the loss of the Thandol Span, while leading the surviving dwarves against the Dark Iron clan.

sections.title: A Bitter Watch
sections.body: Longbraid the Grim rallies the dwarven garrison near the bridge to the Arathi Highlands. The Dark Iron clan seized Dun Modr in a sudden assault that devastated the defenders. Longbraid's brother died during the siege of the Thandol Span. Grief and hatred keep Longbraid at the northern boundary, where he directs travelers and surviving mountaineers in strikes against the Dark Iron advance.

sections.title: Holding the Line
sections.body: Longbraid also directs dwarven operations across the Wetlands. He sent soldiers to escort Prospector Whelgar into the marshlands and works to reclaim Dun Modr's lost fortifications. He vows retribution against the Dark Iron saboteurs.

faq.answer: Longbraid the Grim commands the dwarves stationed outside Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands. He leads the local Alliance resistance against the Dark Iron dwarfs who overran the area.
Longbraid earned his grim demeanor when his brother died in the Dark Iron attack on the Thandol Span. Since then, he has pursued vengeance for his fallen kin.
The Dark Iron clan overran and occupied Dun Modr after ambushing its dwarven garrison. They tried to sever the Thandol Span and cut off the main route between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What is Longbraid's connection to Prospector Whelgar?
faq.answer: Longbraid sent soldiers from his forces to accompany and protect Prospector Whelgar as the dwarven excavation team explored deeper into the hazardous Wetlands.

angles.text: For Ironforge dwarves, Longbraid embodies the fierce blood feud with their Dark Iron cousins, who struck at their northern gateway.
For the Alliance, Longbraid guards Khaz Modan's northern gate and fights to reopen the land route across the Thandol Span into Arathi.
